ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Update
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects update to a scheduled task event that contain suspicious keywords. Note: Unmapped fields: TaskContentNew

sequences.query: (event_id = 4702 AND (TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*")) AND (TaskContentNew = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\<\\/Command\\>.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*cmd\\<\\/Command\\>.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/c\\ .*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/k\\ .*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*\\<Arguments\\>\\/r\\ .*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*pwsh.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*certutil.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*bitsadmin.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*bash\\\.exe.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*bash\\ .*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*scrcons.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*wmic\\ .*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*wmic\\\.exe.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*forfiles.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*scriptrunner.*") OR TaskContentNew = RGX(".*hh\\\.exe.*")))
